definition.inclusion: parsed, valid, non-recap, filled (fill_status == 'filled' and is_recap == 0 and fill_ts present)
exclusion_notes: 29 filled non-recap setups carry no split assignment and are excluded
cohort membership is independent of bar resolution; the 1m re-derivation changes outcomes within the cohort, not membership

split_policy.method: chronological 60/20/20 by posted_at, 39h purge at both boundaries
split_policy.reuse: the archived split id files are reused verbatim; they are not re-cut

assumptions.entry: limit touch at the stated price
assumptions.trail_rule: 1R behind favourable peak, ratcheted, never backward
assumptions.runner_size_at_ftl: half the final tranche trails, half closes
assumptions.intra_bar_ordering: stop wins ties (pessimistic); ambiguous cases flagged and counted

timestamp_convention.note: Timestamps in labeled_setups.csv are NAIVE and already in UTC. This is inherited from the labeller: scripts/store_labeled.py parses them with utc=True before writing to the database, and the export copies the values verbatim.
timestamp_convention.reader_rule: Treat a naive timestamp as UTC. NEVER call .astimezone() on a naive datetime - it interprets the value as LOCAL time and silently shifts every posted_at (and therefore every fill window) by the machine UTC offset.
timestamp_convention.why_it_matters: On a UTC+1 machine this shifted every setup by -1 hour and turned mean net R from -0.0507 into +0.0979 R. See docs/evidence/legacy-reconciliation.md section 4b.

replay_status.note: The archived S0 baseline (data/s0_report.csv) is superseded for expectancy purposes by the paired replay, because the legacy engine never normalised the take-profit ladder. See docs/evidence/legacy-reconciliation.md.
replay_status.legacy_defect: a target on the wrong side of the entry was filled instantly at that target price (pk=452 alone produced -37.46 R)
replay_status.net_effect_on_the_baseline: +0.0378 R per setup, 97% of it carried by 15 setups
replay_status.replay_fills: 1969 of the 1972 cohort rows; the other 3 (pk=9730/9731/9732) have an entirely unreachable ladder and are marked invalid

ftl_population.definition: the final normalised ladder level is touched at any point inside 48h of fill, independent of the exit policy
ftl_population.supersedes: the 1235 (631/296/308) figure quoted in docs/14-redirect-plan.md, which came from an ad-hoc calculation that was never committed as code and cannot be reproduced
